attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `ula` cluster.** Columns 0 to 15 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 8% of calls: `ulaF` to `ulaG`, then `ulaR`, `yjfP`, `bsmA` and `aidB`, [[ascorbate and galactonate catabolism]]. The model names 93 to 99% of them, hesitating most at column 14, 0.53 bits.

**Two variable columns follow**, 16 and 17, in a region of plasticity in 11% of calls, named 94 to 97%. Then a long spine, columns 18 to 43, carried by 90 to 95% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 9% of calls: `rlmB` to `frdD` through `hflC`, `hfq` and `asd`, [[fumarate reduction and protease modulation]]. The model names 74 to 98% there, fewest at column 38 (`yjeM`), 74%, 0.96 bits.

**A short spine follows**, columns 45 to 50, carried by 92 to 93% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 3% of calls, named 97 to 98%, with no column above 0.17 bits. Column 44 and column 51 are variable, named 98% and 95%.

**The window ends in its most hesitant stretch.** Columns 62 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 31 to 88% of calls, named 60 to 86%. Column 64 (`cadA`) is the most hesitant, 1.57 bits, in a region of plasticity in 84% of calls; column 73 is the fewest named, 60%. The fork at column 62 carries `cadC` and a tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase; the variable columns 63 to 78 carry `cadB` to `melR`, [[cadaverine and dicarboxylate transport]], and the fork at column 79 carries `adiA` and `adiY`, in 29% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 92% of genes**, 0.40 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.03 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 60% against 97%.

label: ulaF
facts:
WINDOW: the ulaF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ulaF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,923 to 4,002 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ulaF once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,484 calls, named 97%, 0.13 bits; shell 6,665 calls, named 69%, 1.48 bits; cloud 731 calls, named 17%, 3.90 bits. Outside an RGP 37,075 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 5,805 calls, named 60%, 2.03 bits. Columns: 58 spine, 2 fork, 20 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.03 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (60% against 97%); 5,805 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 64 (cadA) 1.57 bits, RGP 84%; column 65 (dtpC) 1.37 bits, RGP 88%; column 66 (lysS) 1.23 bits, RGP 86%. The 6 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 1.26 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 93%, 0.33 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 62-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 31-88%; the least: columns 52-61 (spine), RGP 1-10%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-15 (16 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-8%. Genes: ulaF, ulaE, ulaD, ulaC "PTS ascorbate transporter subunit I…", ulaB, ulaA, ulaG, ulaR, yjfP "esterase", bsmA, yjfN "DUF1471 family protease activator Y…", aidB, yjfC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…", yjfM "DUF1190 domain-containing protein", yjfL "DUF350 domain-containing protein", yjfK "DUF2491 family protein". named 93-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 15 (yjfK), named 93%; most hesitant at column 14 (yjfL), 0.53 bits.
2. columns 16-17 (2 columns) variable: RGP 11%. named 94-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16, named 94%, 0.30 bits.
   16: yjfJ S 87% "PspA/IM30 family protein"
   17: yjfI S 88% "DUF2170 family protein"
3. columns 18-43 (26 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 3-9%. Genes: rlmB, rnr, nsrR, purA, yjeT "DUF2065 domain-containing protein", hflC, hflK "FtsH protease activity modulator Hf…", hflX, hfq, miaA, mutL, amiB, tsaE, nnr, queG, "hypothetical protein", orn, rsgA, asd, mscM, yjeM "amino acid permease", epmA, frdA, frdB "fumarate reductase iron-sulfur prot…", frdC, frdD. named 74-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 38 (yjeM), named 74%, 0.96 bits.
4. column 44 variable: RGP 3%. named 98%; 0.10 bits.
   44: ampC P 90%
5. columns 45-50 (6 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 3%. Genes: blc, sugE, ecnB "lipoprotein toxin entericidin B", ecnA, efp, epmB. named 97-98% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 45 (blc), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 50 (epmB)).
6. column 51 variable: RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.38 bits.
   51: yjeJ P 89% "YjeJ family protein"
7. columns 52-61 (10 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 1-10%. Genes: yjeI "DUF4156 domain-containing protein", groL "chaperonin GroEL", groS, yjeH "L-methionine/branched-chain amino a…", fxsA, aspA, dcuA, cutA, dsbD, dicD. named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 61 (dicD), named 95%; most hesitant at column 53 (groL), 0.37 bits.
8. columns 62-79 (18 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 31-88%. named 60-86% (mean 75%), fewest named at column 73, named 60%; most hesitant at column 64, 1.57 bits.
   62 fork: cadC S 62%; also "tyrosine-type recombinase/integrase" S 16%
   columns 63-78 variable, share 41-64%, 12 P, 4 S: cadB "cadaverine/lysine antiporter" 63%, cadA 63%, dtpC 63%, lysS 63%, ghoT 63%, ghoS "type V toxin-antitoxin system endor…" 63%, yjdJ "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase" 64%, yjdI "4Fe-4S mono-cluster protein YjdI" 64%, dcuS 64%, dcuR 64%, dcuB "anaerobic C4-dicarboxylate transpor…" 63%, fumB 62%, yjdF "DUF2238 domain-containing protein" 61%, melB 42%, melA "alpha-galactosidase" 57%, melR 41%
   79 fork: adiA P 29%; also adiY P 14%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): ulaF L-ribulose-5-phosphate 4-epimerase UlaF; ulaD 3-keto-L-gulonate-6-phosphate decarboxy…; ulaB PTS ascorbate transporter subunit IIB; ulaA PTS transporter subunit IIC; ulaG L-ascorbate 6-phosphate lactonase; hflC protease modulator HflC; hflX ribosome rescue GTPase HflX; frdA FAD-binding protein; frdC fumarate reductase subunit FrdC; frdD fumarate reductase subunit FrdD; ecnA lipoprotein antitoxin entericidin A; groS co-chaperone GroES; cadA Orn/Lys/Arg decarboxylase N-terminal do…; ghoT type V toxin-antitoxin system toxin GhoT; dcuR two-component system response regulator…; adiY DNA-binding transcriptional activator A…
END: the window ends at column 79, adiA, in 29% of chromosomes.
